pages.title: The Aether's Edge
pages.text: Past the last charted fragment, the sky $(o)thins$(). Surveyors call this the $(l)Aether's Edge$(). It is where the Charter's maps stop being useful and start being polite.$(br2)Source fonts are common past the Edge. So are things the Charter does not have a clerk for.

The Reformers want to colonise the Edge. They have, twice, applied for a survey docket. The Charter has, twice, refused. The reasons given are $(o)"audit difficulty."$()$(br2)The reasons not given are longer.

A senior Foreman who works on the Aether's Edge is doing magic-tech the Charter cannot fully account for. Some Foremen take that as a thrill. The Charter takes it as a $(o)problem to solve later$(). Later, in the Charter, is a long time.
